description: an 'a+' descriptor reads from offset 0 as Node 22's does (O_APPEND moves the offset only for a write): readSync with a null position, readFileSync(fd), a write then a read at the end, a positioned read that keeps the cursor, a write mid-file that appends; appendFileSync(fd) writes at the descriptor's cursor, so an 'a+' one appends and moves it and an 'r+' one overwrites; FileHandle.read and readFile; a read stream on an fd reads from its cursor, to `end` counted from there; path streams with 'a+'
